solutions.title: Extra list of unique values
solutions.strategy: Build a list of values when they differ from the previous value, copy it into the prefix, and return its length.

timeComplexity.explanation: The sorted array is scanned once and the unique values are copied once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The temporary list can contain every value when all inputs are unique.

solutions.title: In-place unique write pointer
solutions.strategy: Keep the next write position and copy a value only when it starts a new unique group.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value is compared to the previous kept value once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The array is compacted in place with only a write index.
